# Art portfolio template

> A portfolio site for an artist: a full-screen portrait with the name set huge, a pinned horizontal run of featured series, a two-column grid of every series, and a sticky-column page per series. Next.js, deployed on Vercel, written to be customised by an AI coding agent.

This file describes the site to assistants and crawlers. The owner replaces this paragraph with who they are and what they make once the site is theirs.

## Pages
- /: portrait, featured series strip, grid of all series
- /work/<series>: one page per series with every piece and a statement
- /about: the artist's story
- /contact: email and address

## For agents customising this repo
- Start with AGENTS.md in the repository root.
- The owner's details live in src/lib/site.ts only.
- Content is Markdown in content/projects with a validated schema; images are in public/art.
- Colours are tokens at the top of src/app/globals.css.
